sahelanthropus-tchadensis.description: A hairy, ape-like creature with a dark face and brown fur stands upright on muddy ground at the edge of a calm, reflective lake at dusk, with dark trees and reeds around it. The painting is loose, oil-like, and fills the whole frame. No text, buildings, or tools are visible.

orrorin-tugenensis.description: A dark-furred, ape-like primate with a bare face walks on two legs along a thick mossy branch in a dense, dim forest. One arm reaches up to grip a bough overhead, the other hangs at its side. Shafts of light and hanging vines fill the background. The painting is an oil-style texture with no visible text, frame or era-specific objects.

ardipithecus-ramidus-appears.description: A dark-furred, chimp-faced ape-like hominin with long arms walks upright on two legs through a dense, dim forest. Buttress roots, vines, ferns and leaf litter surround it, and its foot is splayed with a grasping big toe. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no text, border or signature, and nothing graphic.

australopithecus-anamensis-appears.description: A dark-furred, upright-walking ape-like figure wades through shallow, rippling dark water at the edge of a dense, misty forest. Hanging vines and tangled trees fill the background, with a dim, overcast sky and a grey lake stretching to the left. The painting is edge to edge with no text, frame or border.

laetoli-footprints.description: Two dark, bare-bodied upright figures seen from behind stand on a grey plain, backlit by a bright glow. A trail of footprints in wet grey ash runs from them toward the bottom edge of the frame. A dark volcano with a smoke plume sits in the background under a heavy stormy sky. Painterly, monochrome style, edge to edge with no frame or text.

australopithecus-africanus-appears.description: An oil-style painting of an upright, ape-like hominin with a long torso and a brown, hairy body, walking across rocky ground with a small juvenile clinging to its side. A second dark, ape-like figure stands in the background behind it. The setting is dry scrub with thorny branches, dark broken rocks and dry grass under a dim, warm light. No text, border or frame is visible, and there are no tools or modern objects.

oldowan-stone-tools.description: A painting in a dark, oil-paint style shows two weathered, sinewy hands. The upper-left hand grips a stone hammer striking a rounded cobble that rests on a flat rock. Sparks fly at the point of impact. Scattered flakes of grey stone and a broken animal bone lie in the dirt. The background is near-black, and there is no visible text, frame or border.

paranthropus-boisei-appears.description: A heavily built, dark-skinned hominin with a ridge along the top of its head and a massive jaw sits at the edge of murky water, grasping a fistful of grass and chewing the stems. Dense dark foliage and reeds fill the background, with a pool or marsh to the right. The painting is an oil-style image that runs edge to edge with no visible frame, border or text.

dmanisi-humans-leave-africa.description: Four or five early hominins with heavy brows and robust, bare-skinned builds walk single file along a rocky ridge. One carries a stone and another a leafy bundle; a staff-like stick is visible behind. Below lies a forest and a winding pale river through a valley, with hazy mountains and a dramatic cloudy sky. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge. No visible text, border or frame.

homo-erectus-stands-tall.description: A tall, lean, dark-skinned early human with a heavy brow and short hair strides left across an open savanna at dusk. He is shirtless, wears a ragged hide wrap at the waist, and holds a stone handaxe in one hand. Flat-topped acacia-like trees and low hills sit on a wide horizon under a dark, streaky sky. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square with no frame or text visible.

homo-antecessor-atapuerca.description: Two hunched, pale-brown hominins with heavy brows and dark hair sit at the mouth of a rocky cave under a grey sky. The nearer one holds a small stone flake, cutting into a dark animal carcass with visible raw red meat. Scattered bones, stone flakes and pebbles lie on the cave floor, and a wooded hillside with pine trees is visible outside. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text or frame.

wonderwerk-cave-fire.description: Four figures crouch around a small campfire deep in a dark cave, with bones and sticks on the ground. Smoke and sparks rise from the fire, and a bright opening sits in the far background of the cave. The figures are bare-skinned, with fur on one or two, and hold sticks or small tools. The painting is an oil style with warm browns and dark rock, and fills the frame with no visible border.

neanderthals-emerge-europe.description: A bearded, heavily built man with a brow ridge and shaggy dark hair stands on a snowy hillside, wrapped in a brown fur cloak over bare shoulders and chest, gripping a long wooden spear with a stone tip in one hand and a walking stick in the other. Behind him a winding river runs through a valley of conifers under a dark, stormy sky with distant hills. The scene is a painting with no visible frame, text, or border, and the image fills the canvas edge to edge.

jebel-irhoud-homo-sapiens.description: A group of people sits around a small fire at the mouth of a rock shelter at dusk. One man in the centre knaps a stone with a hammerstone, another kneels at right working a stone tool, and a woman sits behind them. Savanna with grazing antelope and acacia trees stretches out to the left, and a spear leans against the rock at right. Stone flakes lie on the ground and there are bones at the lower right.

misliya-cave-sapiens.description: An oil-style painting of a rock overhang on a hillside above a coastline at dusk. Four hominin figures, mostly bare-chested with simple wraps, sit around a small fire, a couple holding small tools or stone flakes. Scrubby trees, sea and a stormy sky. No text, frame or gore.

denisovans-emerge.description: A bearded, heavy-browed man with long dark hair, wearing a fur cloak and fur-wrapped sleeves, stands at the mouth of a rock cave holding a stone-headed tool. A small fire glows inside the cave. Behind him is a snowy valley with glacier-streaked mountains under a stormy grey sky. The painting fills the whole frame with no border or text.

last-homo-erectus-java.description: A heavy-browed, dark-skinned early human stands barefoot on a muddy riverbank in a jungle at dusk, wearing a leather wrap at the waist and gazing out over a wide brown river. Palms and tangled vines frame the scene under an orange and grey sky. The painting is an oil-style image that runs edge to edge, with only a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner.

homo-floresiensis-hobbit.description: A muscular, barefoot hominin with a heavy brow and short dark hair, wearing a small hide loincloth, creeps through dense tropical forest holding a dark stone tool. Behind it a small tusked elephant walks among ferns. Vines, big trees and filtered light fill a dark oil-painting scene. No text, border or frame; it runs edge to edge.

homo-naledi-appears.description: A crouching hominin with a small, heavy-browed face and long bare arms reaches with curved hands toward a rock wall inside a narrow cave passage. Warm light glows from behind it, and the surrounding limestone is dark and rough. The painting is an oil-style image with no visible text, frame or border.

homo-luzonensis-appears.description: A dark-skinned, hairy-headed, small-bodied hominin climbs a mossy tree trunk in a dense tropical forest, gripping with hands and bare feet. A large limestone cave mouth with hanging vines is at left, ferns in the foreground. Painterly, shafts of light. The figure is unclothed but smooth and anatomically reticent, with no genitals shown. No text, no frame, no blood.

sapiens-neanderthal-interbreeding.description: A dark cave lit by a campfire at the bottom edge. A heavy-browed, muscular hairy man with a bare chest and fur draped over him sits on the left, with one hand resting on a small child. A slimmer long-haired man in a fur coat sits on the right. A toddler in fur clothing sits between them, and sparks rise from the fire. Painterly, no visible text, border or frame.

last-neanderthals-vanish.description: A dim cave mouth frames a dusky coastal plain under a cloudy sky with orange light near the horizon and a sea on the left. Three figures in fur and hide sit around a small fire at the base of the rock wall; the one on the right has a hand on the shoulder of the one beside them, and the one in the foreground is crouched with its back mostly turned. Rough, painterly oil style with no visible text, signature or border.
